capabilities: Create notes from template files via one command per template
Prompt for Mustache-style variables in a fill-in form
Fill YAML frontmatter fields including list properties
Replace selected editor text with a templated string
Configure per-template output directory, filename and note-opening behavior
extras: Author links to an Obsidian Forum discussion thread for support. Uses Luxon date formats for the currentDate field; notes that Moment.js is not recommended for new projects.
intentEvidence: It will go through each file in the templates directory in the settings, and create a command 'From Template: ' for each file.
problem: Obsidian's core Templates inserts a template into the current note but cannot prompt for variable values, create the target note, or write a replacement back into the selected text.
summary: Template-based note creator that adds a command per template file and prompts for Mustache variables before generating the note.
